messages:
ana: FYI running into SSL verify failures using async python SDK through our corporate forward proxy + custom CA. then the client floods auth refresh. anyone have a quick workaround?

rita: seen this: async httpx + proxy handshake often needs an ssl.SSLContext instead of a path for verify. what vars did you set?

ana: set REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/pki/tls/certs/corp.pem and base_url pointing at our Dedicated endpoint. sync calls worked, async failed with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED and then lots of token refresh retries.

chen: quick test snippet that helped me: ```py
import ssl, os, httpx
ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=os.environ['REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE'])
client = httpx.AsyncClient(proxies='http://10.1.2.3:3128', verify=ctx, trust_env=False, base_url='https://dedicated.example.internal')
```
this forces the proxy TLS verify to use your CA.

rida: also note SDK bug: async path starts parallel refreshes when token expires. if proxy returns 502 during refresh you get a thundering herd. opened an issue for adding a refresh mutex + better retry handling.

ana: thanks, SSLContext + trust_env=False fixed it for me. filing a bug and adding the snippet to our internal runbook.

dev-bot: incident note: proxy cert rotation scheduled 2024-11-05T02:00Z may cause transient verify errors.
